contradictions.what: Rep first says the customer was building a portal; later says Paul's team builds nothing and the portal is off the shelf with a plugin.
Rep says the trigger was the portal, then says the portal was the excuse and the real trigger was the new CFO's close.
Rep says not much changed in the customer's questions after the bank call, then describes a new question about a named contact.
Rep cites a three-week stall but later says a month was lost pitching the portal.
Rep had the deal at 20 percent and 'dead' before the data meeting, though the CFO had already said 'go back' and asked to see it with their data.
Rep gives shifting timing: realized the real trigger around the third call, and says it felt won at 'that meeting. Well, the one after.'
Rep says it was paperwork after the business case, yet the reference request stayed open and was raised twice.
